study: MLB full-reset retune of XGBoost + LightGBM (all model parameters free, machine-stable num_threads=1) — rerun on the 2026-10-03 data push
harness: mlb-backend/backend/tune_full.py (frame/baseline/screen/finalists/verify/ensemble/verdict; resumable via sqlite study + runs jsonl + ensemble walk cache)

protocol.frame: data_delivery/game_level_features.csv (2026-10-03 15:58 push, HEAD 2bc6cff) -> decided frame, 7387 games, 86 canonical folds (was 79 on the 2026-10-01 frame)
protocol.tune_set: folds[:-4] (82 folds; screening on the 20 most recent, verification on 8-10)
protocol.operating_points: XGBoost measured at BOTH walk-causal (probe -> median of prior folds' rounds) and refit-static — the standing 2026-09-30 provenance obligation
protocol.machine_stability: OMP/OPENBLAS/MKL/NUMEXPR=1 set before imports; n_jobs=1 + num_threads=1 + deterministic/force_row_wise LightGBM on every fit; XGB_FIXED/LGB_FIXED identity knobs never sampled
protocol.noise_floor_first: incumbent re-measured at 3 seeds (42/7/2026) per member per operating point BEFORE believing any gain (baseline --budget 12)
protocol.seeded_incumbent_reference: challengers paired per (seed, op) against the FULL incumbent params at the same seed (_seeded_base)

search.not_searched: XGBoost n_estimators — it is the causal mechanism (probe -> prior-fold median), not a knob; the LightGBM grid includes n_estimators because for LightGBM it is a direct knob

lightgbm.verdict: CLEARS THE FLOOR — mean |d_tune| 0.00323 is 2.2x the 0.00144 noise floor, sign-consistent 3/3 seeds on BOTH the tune folds and the sealed holdout, and all three finalists are negative on both surfaces. First floor-clearing member gain in five full-reset retunes; a genuine candidate for the owner to consider (params in tune_full_finalists.json cand0).

xgboost.verdict: BORDERLINE at walk-causal — mean d_tune -0.00391 only 4% past the 0.00374 floor (and measured at budget 8 vs the floor's 12), sign-consistent 3/3 seeds with a negative seal; NOT confirmed at refit-static (mean -0.00121 inside the 0.00237 floor, seal positive). Mixed across operating points -> keep unless the owner accepts a causal-only, marginal claim.

pooled_oof_metrics.surface: ALL 82 tune folds (last 4 sealed), seed 42, walk-causal op, n=7019 pooled OOF rows — the verify stage recorded logloss only, so brier/AUC were measured in a dedicated single pass (scratch script, untracked)

xgboost.note: challenger is WORSE on all three metrics on the full tune surface — independent confirmation that XGBoost should be kept

lightgbm.note: challenger improves logloss, brier AND auc on the full tune surface, consistent with the floor-clearing verify result

ensemble_impact: gate OPENED this run (both members had mean d_tune < 0) and the full production walk was measured: incumbent blend logloss 0.6835 / AUC 0.567, BOTH challengers logloss 0.6835 / AUC 0.567 — no movement at published precision (<=1e-4). Last-fold earned weights: xgboost 0.0 (so the xgb challenger cannot move the blend mechanically); the LGB challenger shifted the blend vector elasticnet 0.5016->0.432 / lightgbm 0.4984->0.568 with the pooled blend logloss unchanged at 4dp. Member-level gains do not propagate to the served blend.

adoption.decision: ADOPTED 2026-10-03 — config.LIGHTGBM_PARAMS replaced with the verified winner; config.XGBOOST_PARAMS confirmed unchanged
adoption.production_form_confirmation: paired OLD-vs-NEW as the config dicts will actually ship (LightGBM derived seeds, no harness seed pins), 20 most-recent tune folds, pooled OOF: seed 42 -0.003677, seed 7 -0.001875, seed 2026 -0.001824 (mean -0.00246 vs the 0.00144 floor) — the gain survives without the harness's explicit bagging_seed/feature_fraction_seed pins
adoption.battery: 252 passed after the config change; LGBMClassifier accepts the new kwargs; XGBoost block byte-identical

verdict: OWNER DECIDES. LightGBM cand0 is a real, floor-clearing, sign-consistent improvement of the member (first in five retunes) with zero measured blend harm — the strongest adoption candidate to date, but adopt-or-not is the owner's call. XGBoost stays: its causal-only 4% floor clearance is not robust and the static operating point does not confirm. Note the 2026-10-01 run on the 79-fold frame found NO floor-clearing member; the 2026-10-03 frame (86 folds) flipped that for LightGBM.
